title: THE FREQUENCY BENEATH · title page
venue: private · after a paperback found in the library's return cart · Box 26
logline: The title page, drawn before page one: the masthead over the series' one image, with nobody in it. It letters the title, the subtitle and the tagline. 47

panels.composition: Graph paper filling the page; one unbroken warm oscilloscope trace enters from the left, rises and falls into each letter of the title in turn, and runs flat off the right edge; the subtitle small in the graph's margin; at the bottom edge the paperback's spine, its author's name a shape, the due-date card's corner.
